title: Hierarchical condition x behavior Mirror codes
hypothesis: A condition-specific Givens View composed with shared behavior codes predicts held-out condition-behavior interventions at lower bytes than pair-specific activations and competes with generic full-matrix factorization.
physical_object: Fixed shared 64x4 intervention basis plus per-behavior rank-4 code bank
logical_multiplicity: 12 conditions x 10 behaviors with 20% held-out pair combinations
controls: Explicit pair coefficient table (oracle storage upper control)
One shared behavior code reused across conditions
Generic full 4x4 condition matrix x rank-4 behavior code
Mirror per-condition Givens View x behavior code

task.type: synthetic condition x behavior intervention composition

development.allowed: Choose common Adam optimizer steps from {400,800} by mean Mirror held-out NRMSE; no architecture changes.

success_gate: For every rho=0 fresh world: held-out NRMSE <=.05, Mirror bytes <=80% explicit pair table, and Mirror has a useful quality/byte point over generic full-matrix factorization.
failure_gate: Held-out quality or byte gate fails, or a simpler factorization dominates.
boundaries: Synthetic Givens-aligned only; no pretrained LM or natural behavior-composition claim.
